{
  "objective": "Prioritize four useful, baseline-relative H200 interventions for bounded qualification before allocating either of the two remaining full service attempts. Optimize the frozen Mooncake 0.5x median long-output ITL objective while preserving its correctness, workload and tail constraints.",
  "baseline_comparison": "Compare against the attested H200 seq64 configuration: two TP1/DP4/EP4 replicas, Marlin with allgather_reducescatter, DSpark k5, adaptive verification off, FP8 KV and prefix caching on. Nominal commits are vLLM ac9126e58aa7bbab1856ba6593ba4d5003fea516 and DeepSeek serving 11c249d28b2962f7384b4ab1fd7c1664704e7524; actual installed file hashes and per-experiment manifests govern membership. Supplied C03 observations report ITL +1.8467% and TTFT p99 +7.8332%, with no component causal timing. C01 grouped performance is externally reported unfavorable, with raw evidence unavailable. The task describes C24 qualification as pending; its supplied card reports an instrumentation-inconclusive diagnostic. Neither establishes qualified timing or an adaptive-verification benefit. Preserve those distinctions and do not duplicate concurrent C24 work.",
  "novelty_required": false,
  "novelty_request": "",
  "criteria": [
    {
      "id": "baseline_relative_value",
      "description": "REQUIRED: Provide a credible, testable causal path to improved frozen primary ITL, plus either an identified baseline delta or an explicit cheap inspection test establishing whether the proposed behavior is already present and active. Rank conditional net optimization value after controller, padding, communication and synchronization overhead; record effect size as unknown when unsupported. Activation counts, graph rows and upstream gains are not local time savings. Existing flags, ports and parameter changes qualify. Reopening C03 or grouped C01 requires a new mechanism or evidence and an explicit reopening reason.",
      "category": "improvement",
      "weight": 30,
      "required": true,
      "justification": "C03 changed graph selection without establishing material exposed-time savings. The largest weight therefore rewards a plausible connection to this service objective and a real baseline difference, while allowing inexpensive tests of unknown bottlenecks."
    },
    {
      "id": "bounded_pilot_decision",
      "description": "REQUIRED: Specify a bounded pilot that resolves a material uncertainty before a full service attempt, with adequate opportunity coverage, correctness tests and prospective support/stop/inconclusive rules. Support requires legal activation, relevant correctness passes and timing or cost evidence consistent with useful net savings. Stop for demonstrated incompatibility, correctness failure or adequately measured unfavorable tradeoffs. Missing telemetry, insufficient coverage or unresolved timing associations are inconclusive and defer advancement. Separate research, pilot and full-experiment readiness. Preserve G01-G05 where relevant, graph/cache and numerical checks, quality checks for changed math, and all-rank coverage. Subsequent service evaluation retains the positive screen, 2% promotion requirement, 3% tail guards and at least five paired confirmation blocks for small gains.",
      "category": "testability",
      "weight": 25,
      "required": true,
      "justification": "Only two full attempts remain, and C24 demonstrates that even a completed diagnostic can fail to answer its timing question. Reward pilots whose outcomes change the allocation decision, rather than merely demonstrate activation. Profiled measurements must remain separate from the unprofiled service frontier."
    },
    {
      "id": "engineering_time_and_fit",
      "description": "Declare proposed engineering-hour caps for baseline inspection, implementation, instrumentation and correctness work, distinguishing budget allocations from effort estimates. Identify actual installed code paths and H200 SM90, Marlin, EP4, DSpark and graph compatibility. Prefer smaller changes when they can answer the same question. Unknown implementation cost should trigger a capped feasibility inspection; it must not receive a fabricated estimate. Treat seq128 or broader engine replacement as separate configuration or integration work.",
      "category": "feasibility",
      "weight": 20,
      "required": false,
      "justification": "The installed model_state.py differs from nominal upstream, and an existing controller may avoid an engine port. Engineering time can dominate a small optimization, so this task gives integration and verification effort substantial independent weight."
    },
    {
      "id": "evaluation_gpu_budget",
      "description": "Declare per-candidate future pilot wall-clock and GPU-hour caps, including startup, capture, warmup, measurement and planned retries. Count every allocated GPU: an eight-GPU reservation consumes eight GPU-hours per elapsed hour. Separate pilot costs from any later screen, confirmation and held-out budget. Explain which uncertainty the GPU allocation resolves and use supplied artifact analysis or CPU checks first when sufficient. This research pass uses zero GPU-hours. Node price and candidate savings remain unknown; express monetary cost parametrically and do not infer capacity or cost-per-token gains from fixed-load throughput.",
      "category": "feasibility",
      "weight": 15,
      "required": false,
      "justification": "The scarce resource is an eight-H200 evaluation allocation with only two full attempts remaining. Explicit evaluation cost prevents a nominally cheap optimization from consuming a service-attempt-sized qualification campaign."
    },
    {
      "id": "evidence_and_history",
      "description": "Use implementation or runtime evidence tied to the actual baseline, with short exact quotations and clear separation of reported observations, author claims and transfer inference. Record unknown hardware, workload, effect size and limitations explicitly. Inspect DeepInfer PRs, issues and pinned implementation only when their contents are supplied; links alone establish neither implementation behavior nor compatibility. Upstream SM100/EP64 evidence requires an explicit H200/EP4 transfer argument. Preserve C03's unfavorable screen, C01's missing raw evidence and C24's unresolved qualification without importing prior recommendations as binding policy.",
      "category": "evidence",
      "weight": 10,
      "required": false,
      "justification": "Evidence must prevent unsupported transfer and repeated failed work, but publication volume should not outweigh a cheap, decisive local test. One directly relevant engineering source can justify a pilot; publication novelty and multiple citations are unnecessary."
    }
  ],
  "threshold": 70,
  "evidence": {
    "minimum_independent_sources": 1,
    "require_engineering": true,
    "require_paper_fulltext": false,
    "rationale": "One relevant engineering source is sufficient for pilot consideration; implementation qualification still requires inspection of the relevant actual code or runtime artifact. Supplied reports are evidence of reported results, not independently rechecked artifacts. Reported observations: C03's single matched screen worsened primary ITL and TTFT p99; C24 reports insufficient coverage and unresolved timing associations. Author claims: C24 states, \"The pinned vLLM already contains this controller.\" The C03 mechanism review cautions, \"Rows are not milliseconds.\" Transfer inference: checking that controller's installed behavior and net cost could be useful, but neither statement establishes local savings. Hardware and workload are specified for C03; candidate-specific gains, causal timing, implementation costs and unavailable upstream limitations remain unknown. Abstracts and uninspected URLs are not implementation evidence."
  },
  "retrieval": {
    "github": false,
    "literature": false,
    "rationale": "This response uses only supplied text, as requested. Linked GitHub files, PRs, issues and reports were not inspected. Their missing contents remain evidence gaps. Literature retrieval is unnecessary for deriving this engineering rubric and would not substitute for implementation evidence."
  },
  "rationale": "Weights sum to 100 and reflect this task: expected baseline-relative value 30, pilot decision value 25, engineering time 20, evaluation GPU-hours 15 and evidence quality 10. Each weight is the maximum contribution to a 100-point assessment. The threshold of 70 is an uncalibrated pilot-prioritization choice, not a success probability or service-promotion rule. Unknown judgments remain pending rather than receiving an automatic failing score. Confirmed failure of either REQUIRED criterion vetoes the current proposal regardless of total score; unresolved required judgments defer advancement while permitting a bounded diagnostic designed to resolve them. A high score never authorizes a full service attempt without completed pilot qualification and the frozen evaluator gates. Native agent-f75 8K/1K and H200 seq64 Mooncake anchors remain intact; cache-isolated 1K/1K and long-context, ragged, mixed and cold/warm diagnostics retain separate roles."
}
